mapper.select: SELECT f.festival_id AS id, f.festival_name AS name, f.venue, f.road_addr, f.start_date, f.end_date, f.content, f.host_org, f.mng_org, f.latitude AS lat, f.longitude AS lng, f.type_code, t.type_name FROM festival f JOIN festival_type t ON t.type_code = f.type_code WHERE f.festival_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO festival (festival_name, venue, start_date, end_date, content, host_org, mng_org, road_addr, lot_addr, sido, sigungu, latitude, longitude, type_code) VALUES (#{name}, #{venue}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{content}, #{hostOrg}, #{mngOrg}, #{roadAddr}, #{lotAddr}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{typeCode}) ON CONFLICT (festival_name, start_date, venue) DO UPDATE SET end_date = EXCLUDED.end_date, content = EXCLUDED.content, host_org = EXCLUDED.host_org, mng_org = EXCLUDED.mng_org, road_addr = EXCLUDED.road_addr, lot_addr = EXCLUDED.lot_addr, sido = EXCLUDED.sido, sigungu = EXCLUDED.sigungu, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, type_code = EXCLUDED.type_code, updated_at = now()
